name: Benchmark Matrix
description: ### 1. Overview & Experimental BoundsThis open-access benchmark matrix compiles 540 deterministic residential building envelope thermal load scenarios calculated in accordance with ACCA Manual J (8th Edition, Full Version) and the ASHRAE Handbook of Fundamentals. The dataset provides empirical and computational baselines evaluating Fourier conductive heat transmission across composite multi-layer wall and roof assemblies, fenestration Solar Heat Gain Coefficients (SHGC), and pressure-driven envelope infiltration converted from blower door depressurization tests (ACH50). Scenarios evaluate multi-dimensional variations across:- 5 ASHRAE Climate Zones (CZ-2 through CZ-6) spanning design conditions from -15°F winter design dry-bulb to 95°F summer design dry-bulb.- 4 Wall Assembly Configurations spanning legacy uninsulated 2x4 framing (effective U = 0.106) through advanced 2x6 framing and continuous exterior polyisocyanurate insulation (effective U = 0.040) with 2D framing factor thermal bridging.- 3 Fenestration Regimes: Legacy single clear aluminum (U = 1.05, SHGC = 0.72), double clear metal (U = 0.48, SHGC = 0.58), and high-performance double low-E argon vinyl (U = 0.28, SHGC = 0.24).- 3 Envelope Tightness Regimes: Leaky legacy (8.5 ACH50), code baseline (3.5 ACH50), and aerosol-sealed high performance (1.2 ACH50) converted via Sherman-Grimsrud LBL correlation factors (N = 18.2).- 3 Dwelling Archetypes: Compact (1,500 sq ft), suburban (2,500 sq ft), and large (3,600 sq ft).
